title: Late-Billing Courtesy Rate Card for Charge Reviews (Insulin Pump Program)
content:
Rate card for the late-billing courtesy on the supported charge when a non-covered item charge on an Insulin Pump Program is reviewed. The days run from the posting date of the line's denial to the posting date of the charge under review, in calendar days.

| Days from the line's denial posting to the charge's posting | Late-billing courtesy |
|---|---|
| more than 90 (the late full days) | the supported charge is reduced by 20 percent (the late courtesy percent) |
| more than 45 (the late half days), up to and including 90 | it is reduced by 10 percent (half the late courtesy percent) |
| 45 or fewer | no late-billing courtesy |

**Edge readings (hypothetical):** a charge posted 46 days after the denial takes 10 percent; posted 91 days after, 20 percent; posted 45 days after, none. The count stops at the charge's own posting date, not at the date of the review.
